description: **`push` and `doctor` take a required choice instead of a mode bool.** `safegit push --only-head|--only-branches|--only-tags|--both-branches-and-tags` becomes `safegit push --refs head|branches|tags|both`, and `safegit doctor --diagnose|--fix|--uninstall` becomes `safegit doctor --action diagnose|fix|uninstall`. Neither has a default: a push that does not say which refs it publishes, and a doctor run that does not say what it does with its findings, are refused. The negation spelling that made `--no-only-tags` push HEAD and `--no-fix` run the diagnose path no longer exists at all.
